en: A black and white winter scene showing a snow-covered riverside or canal bank. Leafless trees coated in snow line the left side of the image. In the center and right, there is a dock or quay with a stationary cargo boat named 'Rengen.' The area has a few people and a vendor's stall or wagon. Industrial elements (like a tall smokestack or chimney) are visible in the background.
